description:
A rival standoff plus a record that bears on nothing in it.

The control that catches a pricer whose 'prediction' is a plausible constant with a story attached. Such a pricer passes symmetric_rivals and near_miss - it produces a number and the number looks reasonable - and fails only where the correct answer is zero.

Both halves are required and pre-registration section 2 registers them separately: the record must be PRICED at ~0 and OBSERVED at ~0 when delivered. A prediction of zero that is never checked against a delivery is the MergedDissonanceQuery shape - a readout nobody reads.

What is authored here is the topology and which belief the loose record attaches to. What is NOT authored is any expected price; requirements section 7.

expect.note: Structural properties, checkable by reading the file. `obs_kettle` is cited by no belief, so no belief's provenance can receive it. Not a prediction about what the pricer does.

evidence.summary: The distant supernovae are dimmer than a static model predicts.
The dimming is the same in every direction we have measured.
The kettle in the observatory kitchen has stopped working.

beliefs.proposition: The dimming is best explained by a change in expansion over time.
The dimming is best explained by our position within a large underdense region.

counterfactual.note: The hypothetical attaches to no belief. Structural, not a prediction: with an empty attachment set the record cannot enter any provenance, so `BeliefUpdater._revise` never sees it.
